description: This MCP server's saved settings. get is read-only; update changes the default region and activity logging; secrets (admin) sets the IBM Cloud API key used for Code Engine (not an MCP API key) and the built-in admin password; export and import (admin) back up and restore the settings document. The key is never returned. Call get_schema with name server_settings for every action's fields.

action.description: get: Read version, region, activity log, auth mode, protocols, rate limit, audit, and page lock. | update: Change region and/or activity_enabled. | secrets: Admin. Set the Code Engine IBM Cloud API key (ibmcloud_api_key or code_engine_api_key) and/or admin_password. Omit a field to keep it. The key is never returned. | export: Admin. Return the settings document (no passwords or keys). | import: Admin. Restore a document from export. Needs document.

activity_enabled.description: Write tool calls to the activity log

admin_password.description: Password for the built-in admin sign-in. Omit to keep the current password.

code_engine_api_key.description: Same as ibmcloud_api_key: the Code Engine / IBM Cloud API key. Omit to keep the current key.

document.description: The document field returned by server_settings with action export

ibmcloud_api_key.description: IBM Cloud API key for Code Engine (IBMCLOUD_API_KEY). Not an MCP API key. Omit to keep the current key.

name: server_settings
